root.label: C++26 containers
root.note: inplace_vector, hive, indirect and polymorphic, plus optional as a range, optional<T&> and span::at.

children.label: inplace_vector
children.note: A contiguous sequence container with capacity N fixed in the type and elements stored inside the object (P0843R14).

children.label: Overflow throws bad_alloc
children.note: Any member that would make size exceed N throws bad_alloc; push_back then has no effects.

children.label: try_push_back
children.note: Returns optional<T&>, or nullopt when full, since P3981R2. Older sources show a T* return.

children.label: unchecked_push_back
children.note: Precondition size() < capacity(); violating it is undefined behavior.

children.label: Static capacity
children.note: capacity, max_size and reserve are static; reserve(n > N) throws bad_alloc. Move and swap are linear.

children.label: Triviality passes through
children.note: Trivial copy, move and destruction of T give the same for the vector; N == 0 is empty and trivially copyable.

children.label: constexpr
children.note: Fully constexpr in the draft since P3074R7; GCC 16 supports constant evaluation only for trivial T.

children.label: hive
children.note: Block-based container with constant-time insert and erase that never moves surviving elements (P0447R28).

children.label: Unordered insertion
children.note: insert and emplace take no position; the hint is ignored and erased slots may be reused.

children.label: Stable addresses
children.note: Insertion invalidates only end(); erasure invalidates only the erased elements.

children.label: Skipfield
children.note: The reference implementation skips runs of erased slots in O(1); the draft only says the technique is unspecified.

children.label: Interface limits
children.note: Bidirectional iterators with <=>, no operator[], no ==; sort, unique, splice and get_iterator are members.

children.label: Not in GCC 16
children.note: Neither libstdc++ 16 nor libc++ 21 ships <hive>.

children.label: indirect
children.note: Owns one heap-allocated T, copies it deeply and propagates const (P3019R14).

children.label: Never null normally
children.note: The default constructor allocates a value-initialized T; converting constructors are explicit.

children.label: Value comparison
children.note: == and <=> compare the owned objects, and work against a plain T; hash is provided.

children.label: Incomplete T
children.note: T may be incomplete where the member is declared, so it suits recursive types and pimpl.

children.label: polymorphic
children.note: Owns an object of any type derived from T and copies it as its dynamic type, so nothing is sliced.

children.label: Derived and copyable
children.note: The owned type must derive from T and be copy-constructible; there are no comparisons or hash.

children.label: Valueless after move
children.note: Moved-from indirect is valueless; moved-from polymorphic may or may not be, which permits small buffers.

children.label: optional and span
children.note: Smaller C++26 library changes to existing vocabulary types.

children.label: optional is a view
children.note: begin and end give zero or one elements with contiguous iterators (P3168R2).

children.label: optional<T&>
children.note: Holds a pointer, rebinds on assignment, refuses temporaries, and is a borrowed range (P2988R12).

children.label: span::at
children.note: Throws out_of_range for a bad index (P2821R5); operator[] has only a hardened precondition.

children.label: No initializer_list span
children.note: P2447R6 added it, and P4144R1 removed it in March 2026; libc++ 21 still ships it.
